inline_comments.comment: The changeset message uses past-tense "Updated" with a capital U and an unnecessary article "the". Other changeset files in this repo use present-tense imperative mood (e.g., "fix: warn when `style` statement targets...", "fix: Align branch label..."), and the PR title itself says "fix: update dagre-d3-es to version 7.0.13". Consider aligning to: `fix: update dagre-d3-es to 7.0.13`.

general_comments.comment: `dagre-d3-es` is pinned to an exact version (no semver range) rather than a patch-compatible range like `~7.0.13`. This means every future security patch to this dependency will require a dedicated PR and manual intervention. This is pre-existing behavior maintained by this PR, but given that this update itself was prompted by a CVE, it may be worth evaluating whether switching to `~7.0.x` pinning would allow automatic pickup of future patch-level security fixes without the overhead of a full release cycle.
